title: Raptors to raise Kyle Lowry's No. 7 to rafters in January retirement ceremony
description: The Toronto Raptors will retire Kyle Lowry's No. 7 following their Jan. 10 game against the Philadelphia 76ers.
text:
The Toronto Raptors will retire Kyle Lowry's No. 7 following their January 10 game against the Philadelphia 76ers. The Toronto Raptors will retire Kyle Lowry's No.

7 following their January 10 game against the Philadelphia 76ers. Lowry will become the second player in franchise history to have his number raised to the rafters at Scotiabank Arena, joining Vince Carter. The 40-year-old guard retired in July after signing a one-day contract with Toronto to end his 20-year NBA career as a Raptor.
